text: ← All problemsPositivity of real H-eigenvalues for reflected order-four Steiner distance tensorsLet $T$ be a finite tree on $n\ge2$ vertices. For an ordered quadruple of vertices, including repeated terminals, let $M_{ijkl}$ be the minimum number of edges in a connected subgraph containing those terminals. Let $J$ be the all-ones $n\times n$ matrix and $A=2J/n-I$. Reflect the last slot: $(C_1)_{ijkl}=\sum_h M_{ijkh}A_{hl}.$ Using the first-free-index H-eigenvalue convention, a real H-eigenpair is a real number $\lambda$ and a nonzero vector $x\in\mathbb R^n$ such that $\sum_{j,k,l}(C_1)_{ijkl}x_jx_kx_l=\lambda x_i^3\quad\text{for every }i.$ Positivity question. Must every such real H-eigenvalue be positive for every tree $T$? This is the order-four case of the reflected-tensor positivity question on pp. 9–10 of Cooper–Du. The reflection need not leave a fully symmetric tensor, so the coordinate convention is explicit. This question is separate from the hyperdeterminant-sign conjecture and from positivity results for $C_1+C_3$.ReferencesJ. Cooper and Z.
